tools.name: search_compute_contracts
tools.description: Use when you need to find compute derivative contracts. Searches futures and options on GPU rental indices by venue, status, index publisher, jurisdiction, settlement or name. 50 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC on Base per call via x402.

tools.name: get_compute_record
tools.description: Use when you have a record id (ct-, ser-, ent- or ev-) and need it in full. Returns its classification, status history, held-back fields and every source. 50 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC on Base per call via x402.

tools.name: compute_market_events
tools.description: Use when you need dated events on compute derivatives. Lists announcements, filings, regulator actions and dates still to come, filtered by date, type or contract. 50 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC on Base per call via x402.

tools.name: compute_list_prices
tools.description: Use when you need GPU rental list prices with their history. Every AWS and Azure line, one per region and instance, never averaged, per instance-hour and per GPU-hour, with every change since 2020. 50 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC on Base per call via x402.

tools.name: compute_query
tools.description: Use when you need to filter, group, rank or chart compute market data in one call. Takes the console's query object and returns lines, headline numbers, a league table, contracts, events and sources. 50 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC on Base per call via x402.

tools.name: get-gpu-price
tools.description: Use when you need what one cloud charges, or what hosts ask on a marketplace, to rent a GPU now. Returns the price per GPU-hour, its type, last change, source and read time; for an ask, the seller's rented share as reported. 50 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC on Base per call via x402.

tools.name: find-cheapest-gpu-hour
tools.description: Use when you need the cheapest place to rent a given GPU. Compares USD list prices per GPU-hour, optionally in one region, and returns the cheapest with its source. Other currencies are named, not compared. Asks only when asked. 50 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC on Base per call via x402.

tools.name: list-price-changes
tools.description: Use when you need to know whether GPU rental prices moved. Lists list-price changes since a date for one chip or provider, newest first, up to 100 rows, each with its source. 50 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC on Base per call via x402.

tools.name: get-compute-contract
tools.description: Use when you need one compute derivative contract in full. Returns its terms, status history, the index it settles against and its venue, with sources. Index values are not returned. 50 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC on Base per call via x402.

tools.name: list-regulator-actions
tools.description: Use when you need what regulators have done about traded compute. Lists regulator actions and due dates on compute derivatives since a date, newest first, with sources. 50 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC on Base per call via x402.

tools.name: list_compute_coverage
tools.description: Use when you need to know what the DAP Compute Market Index covers before concluding something does not exist. Returns the snapshot date, counts and every source. Free.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "compute_list_prices" appears informational but accepts parameters (history) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: gpu, provider, instance, region, price_type, since, until, history

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_compute_contracts" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search every compute derivative contract the Compute Market Tracker records (futures and options on GPU rental and compute price indices) by venue, status, index publisher, jurisdiction, settlement or name. Returns each contract with its status, the index it settles against, its DAP Standard classif" → after: "Use when you need to find compute derivative contracts. Searches futures and options on GPU rental indices by venue, status, index publisher, jurisdiction, settlement or name. 50 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC on Base per call via x402."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
